content_data.meeting_title: Content Strategy Alignment for Q3 European Market Growth
agenda_items: Aligning content creation workflows with SEO best practices and localization needs
Review of current content performance metrics across key European markets (Germany, France, UK)
Defining content requirements for upcoming product launches and promotional campaigns
key_decisions: Launch a series of interactive content pieces (quizzes, configurators) to improve user dwell time.
Allocate resources for external content creators specializing in niche European e-commerce segments.
action_items: **SEO Specialist**: Conduct a keyword gap analysis for key product categories in target European markets, due in 14 days.
**Marketing Manager**: Research and present 3-5 external content creator agencies with European market expertise, due in 10 days.
